title: Every record carries the site's tenant id from the first deploy
description:
The second site will share this deployment, so the first site's records must already be marked as its own.

```gherkin
Feature: Tenant id from day one

  Scenario: New records are stamped
    Given the deployment has a tenant id for the first site
    When a Story, a Reference and an image are created
    Then each record carries that tenant id
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID=the-hallucinator is set on the app's main branch from the first deploy (stack humorus-app-shell). Whether a Reference carries it for browser-side writes is not proven in Papyrus (see the plan on PPY-e5d1fb).
